policies.failureSafety: Use native crafting transactions and vanilla container remainder behavior. Narrative delivery records idempotent accomplishment separately and grants no copy of the crafted output. No timer decay or forced chunks.
policies.containers: Preserve native recipe remainders for consumed soups/stews; verify bowls return normally in crafting and AE2 automation.
policies.decorativeMods: Optional building exercises with screenshots/manual checkmarks; no mandatory decorative ingredients.
policies.massProduction: Repeatable static crafting is compatible with ordinary crafting tables and existing autocrafting. No new tick handlers or machine scanning.
policies.narrativeAcceptance: Crafting, possession and gifts never complete a narrative project. Act II requires first_signal and explicit authoritative server delivery consuming one prototype per project; machines remain installed. Tutorial exercises are self-reported, never machine-demo validation. Later-act demonstrations remain proposals, not implemented acceptance. No provenance checks.

resourceStages.policy: Food, ordinary crops and basic bees stay open; no gating of recipes for sorting/building/travel recovery.

Add one propagation_core to static recipes for selected resource seeds/breeding upgrades at iron/copper/redstone tier. Do not remove seed use, growth, inheritance, gifts, or base recipes. Exact affected recipe IDs must be resolved from loaded registry before implementation.
Gold, quartz, specialized breeding and dimensional resource automation add one ecosystem_capsule; retain native material costs and progression. Avoid touching normal decorative/food crops.
